review.summary: Independently repeated original linker --list mapping and native-created library records, 26 finite-platform controls, and seven original membership queries in a separate protected guest. All reports match exactly. Target remains unrelocated; game registration, external-action integration, complete state/reset and ordinary-match equivalence remain open.

evidence: Base and ARM64 split pass APK v3 and SourceStamp verification; manifest reports 160402020.

Signed build-160402020 install-time pack acquired; all 17,307 fingerprint entries match (10,719 ZIP files and 6,588 SQLite BLOBs), including 389/389 csv_logic files. Later live updates remain unverified. Original decoder independently reproduces all 419 compressed occurrences in the 421-input diagnostic manifest, with exact bytes and full consumption; two raw JSON inputs remain unchanged. A separate original container path passes three unchanged files. Neither proves live update selection or full Android resource startup.
JADX processed 9,575 input classes with 200 errors; startup and JNI declarations recovered.
libg ELF metadata yields 566 dynamic-symbol entries including createGameMain and JNI_OnLoad.
Decoded configuration identifies /proc/self/maps, the supporting library, and dispatch offset 0x681780.

Repeated diagnostic health/position streams match across 905 samples. Original Android linker initialization, a finite-file --list mapping and seven native library-membership cases independently reproduce exact reports. The mapped target remains unrelocated; game library registration, ordinary Android startup and battle equivalence remain incomplete.
All 160/160 original checksums match across the 184,872-byte protection-runtime tail region; a one-bit negative control leaves 159/160 matches. This checks recovered bytes, not battle equivalence.

Complete repeated diagnostic position streams match at 905 boundaries and 9,247 actor observations; 617 unknown-class rows remain unpositioned. All prior visual-only samples also match. Complete movement state and Android comparison remain pending.

Original world code selects targets without host target assignment in a 400-tick Knight/KingTower fixture; seven original target-setter entries occur. Full arenas, activation rules and all targeting states remain unvalidated.
Original arena collision and neighbor search execute during 60 synthetic movement ticks. Complete troop overlap, pushing and avoidance behavior remains unvalidated.

Repeated full diagnostic captures match 8,160 observations with HP present, 470 getter-unavailable rows and 617 unknown-class rows, retaining zero HP distinctly. The prior 400-tick melee/projectile fixture and 5,425 original leaf calls support the scoped reader. Full-state and ordinary-match combat equivalence remain unvalidated.

Original KingTower records, spawn and starting-action enqueue run alongside projectile combat in a 400-tick fixture. Normal inactive/activation behavior and complete match-level tower semantics remain unvalidated.

Two synthetic 400-tick runs match all 51,613,696 mapped guest bytes by per-region hashes, 87 listed registers and typed adapter observations per tick. Complete VM/state coverage and an independent Android battle comparison remain absent; exactness is not validated.
